item_name: Rothco Deluxe EMT Low Profile Cap
item_short_desc: Rothco’s Deluxe EMT Low Profile Cap is made from a durable 100% brushed cotton twill, featuring a raised 3-D embroidered “EMT” text on the front panel as well as the brim. This hat also features a hook and loop closure in back for adjustability.
